row.title: CODE-REGULATOR-1 stray ledger file committed
row.body: CI openstd check failed on a committed .regulator.sqlite: the schema command opened the default database in the working directory and git add -A then picked it up. Fixed at the cause: schema answers before any database is opened, the local ledger and its WAL files are ignored by git, and the open-standards check passes. Ran 20 regulator tests, they pass and leave no file behind. The test_ideas failure on this PR also fails on main, so it is not this change.
row.probe: grep:foundation/regulator/cli.py::do not create the default database file
